# Importing existing resources

These resources import by id: `nemau_instance`, `nemau_snapshot`,
`nemau_network`, `nemau_subnet`, `nemau_floating_ip`, `nemau_security_group`,
`nemau_volume`, `nemau_load_balancer`, `nemau_dns_zone` and
`nemau_dns_zone_verification`. Clusters and containers import by name. A
security group rule, which the API only serves within its group, imports by
group id and rule id:

```shell
terraform import nemau_network.app 2a9f4e7c-1d3b-4a85-b6e2-7c0d9f3a5e16
terraform import nemau_kubernetes_cluster.prod prod   # clusters by name
terraform import nemau_container.backups backups      # containers by name
terraform import nemau_dns_zone.main 3f1c9a2e-7b4d-4e8a-9c61-2d5f0b8e4a17               # zones by id, not by name
terraform import nemau_dns_zone_verification.main 3f1c9a2e-7b4d-4e8a-9c61-2d5f0b8e4a17  # the zone's id
terraform import nemau_security_group_rule.https 9b5d3e1f-2a7c-4f68-9d41-6e8a0c3b7f25:5c1a8e3d-7b4f-4a92-8e60-2d9f1b6c4a57  # <group id>:<rule id>
```

With Terraform 1.5 or later, an `import` block does the same from the
configuration:

```terraform
import {
  to = nemau_network.app
  id = "2a9f4e7c-1d3b-4a85-b6e2-7c0d9f3a5e16"
}
```

An imported `nemau_kubernetes_cluster` adopts its first node pool, the one
created with it, as `default_node_pool`.

The other resources cannot be imported. For `nemau_container_credential` and
`nemau_load_balancer_certificate`, the API never returns the secret or the
private key, so an imported resource would be unusable. Create a new one
instead.

A new security group starts with two egress rules that allow all outbound
traffic. Importing them is how they come under Terraform management; the
[networking guide](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/nemau-cloud/nemau/latest/docs/guides/networking)
shows how.
